tools.description: One published GigXchange Index monthly issue by slug (e.g. "september-2026" - get_index_summary lists them): headline description, key figures, context, FAQ, PDF and open-dataset links (HuggingFace, Kaggle, Zenodo DOI).

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Live counts across GigXchange: members by type, venues, open mics, cities, and upcoming gigs listed in the directory (concerts to see, not work to apply for; gigs open for applications are in search_open_gigs).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Public profile for a GigXchange member by URL slug (display name, bio, genres, location, ratings).

tools.name: get_epk
tools.description: Public electronic press kit for an artist by URL slug (summary, genres, rating, media counts).

tools.name: get_gig
tools.description: Full detail for a single directory gig — line-up, address, times, tickets. Use the city_slug + slug from a search_gigs result.

tools.name: get_open_mic
tools.description: Full detail for a single open mic night — schedule, signup, slot length, backline, address. Use the slug from a search_open_mics result.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Full detail for a single grassroots venue — capacity, PA, backline, genres booked, curfew, address. Use the slug from a search_venues result.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Public detail for an event hosted on GigXchange by URL slug — date, venue, ticketing, organiser.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: UK cities where GigXchange has members, with a member count each. Use for "do yo cover <city>?".

tools.name: list_member_spotlights
tools.description: Index of published Member Spotlight features — long-form profiles of real GigXchange members. Newest first.

tools.name: get_member_spotlight
tools.description: Full editorial text of one Member Spotlight issue by slug, plus a link to the member profile it features.

tools.name: my_profile
tools.description: The signed-in member's own profile: name, type, bio, location, verification, rating. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: my_unread_messages
tools.description: Count of the member's unread messages. Returns a COUNT only — message contents are never exposed.

tools.name: my_bookings
tools.description: The member's own bookings from 30 days ago onwards — status, date, venue/event, agreed fee, and which side they are on. Max 25.

tools.name: my_invoices
tools.description: Status and amounts of the member's invoices, both directions — each row carries direction: "sent" (issued by the member) or "received" (billed to them). Payment-processor identifiers are never exposed.

tools.name: list_help_topics
tools.description: The full map of GigXchange's official help centre — every category and the questions it answers. Use for "what can you help me with?" or to see what the help centre covers. Topics not listed here are not covered by the help centre.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Searches GigXchange's help articles — its own documentation of how the platform works (payments, fees, deposits, cancellations, bookings, profiles, messages, account, what to do when something goes wrong). Returns matching articles with their url, or no results when the help centre does not cover a

tools.name: get_help_article
tools.description: The full text of one official GigXchange help article, by slug from a search_help result.

tools.name: my_availability
tools.description: The member's OWN availability for a date window. GigXchange is free-by-default: they are bookable on every date EXCEPT the marked ones this returns (unavailable / soft_hold / confirmed_booking). Default window 90 days, max 365.

tools.name: check_member_availability
tools.description: Whether ONE named member (artist or venue, by profile id from search/get_profile) is free on a specific date. Free-by-default: "available" means nothing is marked against that date. Use for "is X free on the 14th?"; finding WHO is free is search_available_performers.

tools.name: set_my_availability
tools.description: Set a date on the member's own GigXchange calendar: unavailable, soft_hold (pencilled), or available (clears the manual entry). Same statuses the app's calendar offers; a booked night comes from a real booking, never by hand; only touches manual entries — never booking-derived ones. Requires the mem

tools.name: toggle_my_favourite
tools.description: Toggle a GigXchange profile (by slug) in the member's favourites list. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: mark_my_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all of the member's GigXchange notifications as read. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: set_my_fee_range
tools.description: Update the member's own public fee range (GBP, min and max) shown on their profile — the same field as the app's profile editor. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: respond_to_booking
tools.description: Accept or decline a booking offer the member RECEIVED (never one they sent). expected_fee must equal the current fee on the booking (refused otherwise). Declining requires a short reason (relayed to the other party) and is limited to 3 per day. Accepting can start the payment flow. Requires the memb

tools.name: counter_booking
tools.description: Propose  a different fee on a pending booking offer (posts an amended offer card in chat, retiring the old one). expected_current_fee must match the booking; the new fee must stay within 50-200% of it, and only one counter per booking per day. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Send a booking offer to another GigXchange member — the recipient gets a pending booking, a notification and an offer card in Messages, exactly as if the member had sent it in the app. Supported pairs: venue/promoter/organiser to artist, artist to venue/promoter, promoter to venue. Offers involving

tools.name: apply_to_gig
tools.description: Apply the member to an open gig from search_open_gigs (GigXchange member-posted gigs only). The offered fee comes from the gig's listed budget — there is no fee parameter. One live application per gig, 5 per day. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: set_my_bio
tools.description: Replace the member's own public profile bio (plain text, max 1500 chars). The previous bio is returned and included in the member's notification for easy recovery. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a text message into one of the member's EXISTING GigXchange conversations (no new conversations). Max 2000 characters, 10 per conversation per day. The exact text sent is returned. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

tools.name: submit_my_invoice
tools.description: Send one of the member's own DRAFT settle-privately invoices to its GigXchange recipient (notifies them + posts the invoice card in chat). Platform-generated booking invoices are refused — GigXchange sends those automatically. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_index_summary, get_index_issue, get_profile, get_epk, get_gig, get_event, get_member_spotlight, search_help, mark_my_notifications_read · Public sink: make_offer, send_chat_message, submit_my_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_index_summary, get_index_issue, get_profile, get_epk, get_gig, get_event, get_member_spotlight, search_help, mark_my_notifications_read · Public sink: make_offer, send_chat_message, submit_my_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
